description: Configurable demo scenarios for portfolio/live-ops walkthroughs.

scenarios.title: Normal Load
scenarios.description: Healthy fleet baseline for Command Center, query performance, and normal-pressure comparison.
talk_track: Start with healthy fleet telemetry.
Show multidimensional pressure cards staying stable.
Use this as the comparison baseline before triggering an incident.

scenarios.title: Weekend Event Meltdown
scenarios.description: High-density event traffic that should produce frame, replication, and player-impact incidents.
talk_track: Trigger a live event pressure scenario.
Show Command Center pressure rising.
Open Incident Dossier and Incident Timeline to explain the evidence chain.
Assign owner and add a note in Incident Workflow.

scenarios.title: Network Packet Pressure
scenarios.description: Network-heavy traffic for packet-out, packet-loss, rubberbanding, and desync analysis.
talk_track: Show network and replication pressure becoming dominant.
Use drilldown to identify affected source/region/server scope.
Validate player-impact guardrails through Incident Dossier.

scenarios.title: AI Pathfinding Spike
scenarios.description: AI pathfinding pressure scenario for simulation degradation and root-cause timeline review.
talk_track: Show AI pressure rising before frame degradation.
Use configurable root-cause stages to explain the incident sequence.
Review recommendations and guardrails.

scenarios.title: Memory Pressure
scenarios.description: Memory pressure scenario for persistent-session degradation and memory-specific recommendations.
talk_track: Show memory becoming a first-class pressure dimension.
Use incident filters to isolate memory_pressure recommendations.
Assign owner in Incident Workflow.

scenarios.title: Physics Spike
scenarios.description: Physics-heavy gameplay scenario for collision/overlap pressure and simulation impact.
talk_track: Show physics pressure and local anomaly score.
Open Baseline Intelligence to compare current physics against expected ranges.
Review whether the spike is normal for that map/zone or truly anomalous.

scenarios.title: Build Regression
scenarios.description: Two-build scenario: baseline build followed by a candidate build with synthetic regression.
talk_track: Generate two builds in the same time window.
Open Build Regression.
Compare 0.2.0 against 0.2.1 and review PASS/WATCH/BLOCK outcome.
Show most regressed map/zone and metric ranking.

scenarios.title: Fix Validation
scenarios.description: Control/treatment validation for a replication-radius optimization with guardrail monitoring.
talk_track: Generate control and treatment variants.
Open Fix Validation.
Show primary metrics improving while guardrails remain safe.
Explain how the result closes the detect → recommend → validate loop.

scenarios.title: Custom Rule Trigger
scenarios.description: High-pressure traffic intended to exercise configurable recommendation rules.
talk_track: Open Rule Testing or Recommendation Rules.
Show that users can configure issue conditions and solutions.
Trigger incident output and review evidence-backed recommendations.
